Title: Rohan's Day

Cast

1. Rohan - 9 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Meenakshi - 35 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Karan - 39 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt

Places

1. The garden - flower beds, a mango tree
2. The classroom - a blackboard, benches

Scene 1: The garden - Day

[Rohan stands in the garden. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Meenakshi: "Rohan, what's the plan today?"

[Rohan waters the plants.]

Rohan: "Hey, look at that!"

[Rohan chases a butterfly in the garden.]

Meenakshi: "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 2: The classroom - Day

Meenakshi: "Rohan, look over here."

[Rohan raises his hand to answer.]

Rohan: "Okay."

[Rohan writes on the blackboard.]

Rohan (laughing): "Careful!"

[Rohan reads his book at his desk.]

Rohan: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
